batch.pick: chip_amount 1.35, thatch_roll 1.3, thatch_lump 1.25, sag 1.0, chip_count 1.0 (judged by looking, the sheet showed nearly no difference between the variations except the chips)

deviations: ridge about 5.6 m above the ground (not 4.9): 50 degree pitch, 2.0 m eaves, 4.8 m span and a 0.3 m thatch slab make 4.9 impossible
studs are made with role timber.beam (a joined object with the role timber.post would be leaned as one piece by the damage step); the posts are timber.post, one object each
cottage B (stone walls) has no studs or wall panels and no tie beam (a 3.6 m tie would pass the 2.5 m beam limit of the construction verb)
relief objects (walls, panels, thatch, shingles) carry pk_bevelled and no bevel modifier; small boxy objects carry their own one-segment bevel
